/.title: NYU Vocollision - Competitive Acapella Group at New York University
/.description: Vocollision is a competitive acapella group from NYU taking the next step towards the new sonic of modern acapella.
p: Vocollision - a premier competitive acapella group from NYU pushing the boundaries of what modern acapella can be.
Recognized by the International Championships of Collegiate Acapella
This whole set is a great example of putting your stamp on acapella and its evolution

Since our founding in 2008, Vocollision has not been afraid to take risks in combining classic pop ballads with songs by lesser-known artists in our arrangements. From Ariana Grande to the beats of Tyler, the Creator, our performances are celebrations of our members and the music we love.
We are an acapella family that challenges the norms of collegiate acapella and singing together.
We focus on diverse genres, new sounds, and unique storytelling.
We craft stories with every set we perform through our chreography to our song choices.
As our pre-show bio says, we’re “a family that likes to chill and have fun, but is ready to kick ass when the time comes”! In our opinion, the best part about Vocollision is how we all get along.
Vocollision is not competitive within itself. Our goal is to lift each other up and create opportunities for each member to shine.
Want to collaborate? Want to audition? We’d love to work with you!

/audition.title: Audition | Vocollision - Competitive Acapella Group at New York University
/audition.description: Vocollision is a competitive acapella group from NYU taking the next step towards the new sonic of modern acapella.
p: ALL voice parts, BEATBOXERS, AND MAJORS are WELCOME
Submissions close on Friday, March 27th at 11:59pm

Record a video of yourself singing a verse and a chorus of any song without accompaniment that showcases your vocal talents and range (preferably no musical theater or classical)! If you know how to beatbox, feel free to include a sample of your skills in your video too!
Upload the video to YouTube (it can be unlisted or public)
Submit your audition using the form below
Be sure to submit your audition sooner rather than later. This will help us during the  review process!
If you've auditioned for us before, we'd love to hear you again!
Be sure to submit your audition sooner rather than later. This will help us during the review process!
We know auditions can feel intimidating, but we want you to know that we’re so excited to hear you. Vocollision is a family, and we truly WANT you to feel welcome here. 💜

After submitting, if we feel it's a good fit, we'll get back to you within a few days to invite you to an in-person callback. There'll be multiple time options for your in-person callback so don't stress over keeping your schedule open!
In the meantime, stay connected and get to know us better by following @vocollision for updates, behind-the-scenes, and more!
If you have any questions or concerns, email us at nyu.vocollision@gmail.com and we'll get back to you immediately.

/about.title: About | Vocollision - Competitive Acapella Group at New York University
/about.description: Vocollision is a competitive acapella group from NYU taking the next step towards the new sonic of modern acapella.
p: Vocollision is a dynamic group from NYU dedicated to pushing the boundaries of modern acapella. We explore new techniques, genres, styles, and songs.
Founded in 2008 as an Asian-interest acapella group, we’ve since expanded into a community that values diversity and creativity on a wider scale.

We are a family of talented vocalists and musicians, each of us bringing different perspectives and ideas that influence our sound. Together, we craft performances that showcase the power and versatility of the human voice (and captivate audiences and judges!).
